content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes municipal and farm equipment such as sweepers and mowers, not roofing, insulation or glass products."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical ingredients for personal care and pharma, unrelated to roofing or insulation manufacturing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Wood products and lumber distribution; shares builder customers but makes different products than roofing and insulation."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Makes roofing membranes and insulation sold through roofing contractors and distributors, closely matching Owens Corning's core lines."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Architectural cladding is a small part; core is oilfield perforating systems and clad metal plates, not roofing or insulation."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, polymers and fibers sold to industrial manufacturers; no shingle, insulation or glass reinforcement overlap."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Chlor-alkali chemicals and ammunition; no overlap with roofing, insulation or glass fiber products."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mainly coatings, sealants and consumer paints; roofing is one segment, not the core product set of shingles and insulation."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Structural connectors, anchors and fasteners; shares builder and dealer customers but makes different products."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Turf equipment, irrigation and snow throwers sold to landscapers and homeowners; a different product business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Recreational vehicles and buses built from purchased chassis; unrelated to building materials manufacturing."}]}
